steps.en: Hand the hook your values, limits and step size
steps.zh: 把数值、上下限和步长交给 hook
steps.code: useRanger({ values, min: 0, max: 100, stepSize: 5, onChange })

steps.en: While a thumb is pressed it tracks the pointer across the document and snaps pixels to stepped values
steps.zh: 拖把手时它跟踪 document 上的指针，把像素吸附成步进值

steps.en: Place your own track and thumbs using its percentages and handle objects
steps.zh: 用它的百分比和把手对象摆放自己的轨道与把手

steps.en: On release or arrow-key step it sorts the values and fires onChange with the final set
steps.zh: 松手或按方向键后排序数值，带最终结果触发 onChange

value.en: Multi-handle, stepped sliders in markup and CSS that stay entirely yours — the drag tracking, snapping and value math are no longer yours to write
value.zh: 多把手、可步进的滑块，标记和 CSS 完全归你——拖拽跟踪、吸附和数值数学不用再自己写

sources: docs/quick-start.md and examples/react/basic/src/main.tsx (useRanger({ values, min: 0, max: 100, stepSize: 5, onChange }), rangerInstance.getPercentageForValue(value), handles())
packages/ranger/src/index.ts (handlePress attaches mousemove/touchmove on document; handleDrag -> roundToStep; handleRelease sorts and calls onChange; handleKeyDown arrow keys)
docs/framework/react/api/basic.md (onChange called when the handle is released; handles() shape)
